stemMarkdown: An arithmetic progression has first term 6 and common difference 9. Find the average of its first 15 terms. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: For evenly spaced terms the average is the midpoint of the first and last. The last term is $6 + 14 \times 9 = 132$, so the average is $\dfrac{6 + 132}{2} = 69.0$.
